scenarios.title: A｜假装不知道
scenarios.setting: 玩家无意中听见两个同事在茶水间谈论自己，但他们没有发现玩家听到了。之后其中一个人正常过来聊天。

turns.text: Hey, are you coming to lunch with us?

turns.prompt: 你想确认位置或前往的路线，会怎么问？

choices.text: Yeah, maybe. Where are you guys going?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, maybe. Where are you guys going?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: I haven’t decided yet. What time are you leaving?

feedback.naturalExpression: I haven’t decided yet. What time are you leaving?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Probably. I’ll let you know in a bit.

feedback.naturalExpression: Probably. I’ll let you know in a bit.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I think I’ll skip lunch today, but thanks for asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ll skip lunch today, but thanks for asking.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: Everything okay? You seem a little quiet.

turns.prompt: 你想回应关心，同时暂时不展开这件事，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I’m fine. Just focused on work today.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m fine. Just focused on work today.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’m okay. I’ve just got a lot on my mind.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m okay. I’ve just got a lot on my mind.
feedback.explanation: “on my mind”表示一直惦记或在想的事情，可以用来解释自己为什么分心。

choices.text: Everything’s fine. I’m just having a busy day.

feedback.naturalExpression: Everything’s fine. I’m just having a busy day.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Yeah. Why do you ask?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. Why do you ask?
feedback.explanation: “why do you ask”询问提问的原因，适合先了解对方为什么关心这件事。

turns.prompt: 你想礼貌说明自己不接受或不方便，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m good, thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m good, thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

scenarios.title: B｜直接询问
scenarios.setting: 玩家决定不继续猜测，而是私下找其中一位同事。

turns.prompt: 你想就听到的议论，主动找同事澄清，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, can I ask you something directly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, can I ask you something directly?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: There’s something I overheard earlier that I’d like to clear up.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s something I overheard earlier that I’d like to clear up.
feedback.explanation: “I overheard”交代自己听到的信息；如果只听到部分内容，还应留出核实的空间。

choices.text: I heard part of your conversation earlier, and I think you were talking about me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I heard part of your conversation earlier, and I think you were talking about me.
feedback.explanation: “I heard”交代自己听到的信息；如果只听到部分内容，还应留出核实的空间。

choices.text: If there’s an issue with me or my work, I’d rather you tell me directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: If there’s an issue with me or my work, I’d rather you tell me directly.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Why are you talking behind my back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, can I ask you something directly?
feedback.explanation: “behind my back”带有被背叛的指责；如果只听到片段，先说明听到了什么再核实更稳妥。

turns.prompt: 关于「同事背后议论自己」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I heard you say that I’m difficult to work with.

feedback.naturalExpression: I heard you say that I’m difficult to work with.
feedback.explanation: “I heard”交代自己听到的信息；如果只听到部分内容，还应留出核实的空间。

choices.text: I didn’t hear everything, which is why I’m asking you directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I didn’t hear everything, which is why I’m asking you directly.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I heard my name and part of the conversation. I don’t want to make assumptions.

feedback.naturalExpression: I heard my name and part of the conversation. I don’t want to make assumptions.
feedback.explanation: “I heard”交代自己听到的信息；如果只听到部分内容，还应留出核实的空间。

choices.text: If I’ve done something that’s bothering you, I’d rather talk about it openly.

feedback.naturalExpression: If I’ve done something that’s bothering you, I’d rather talk about it openly.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: Honestly, I’ve just been frustrated with how we’ve been communicating lately.

turns.prompt: 你想请同事直接说出不满的具体原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Can you tell me specifically what’s been frustrating you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Can you tell me specifically what’s been frustrating you?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: That’s fair. I’d rather talk about the actual problem than hear about it secondhand.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. I’d rather talk about the actual problem than hear about it secondhand.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I’m willing to hear you out. What do you think isn’t working?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m willing to hear you out. What do you think isn’t working?
feedback.explanation: “what do you think”邀请对方给出意见，不替对方作决定。

turns.text: I feel like you sometimes make decisions without checking with the rest of us.

turns.prompt: 关于「同事背后议论自己」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Okay, I can see why that would be frustrating. Let’s talk about how we can handle that better.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I can see why that would be frustrating. Let’s talk about how we can handle that better.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Thanks for telling me directly. I’ll keep that in mind.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for telling me directly. I’ll keep that in mind.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I may see it differently, but I understand your concern.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may see it differently, but I understand your concern.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

scenarios.title: C｜与其他同事讨论
scenarios.setting: 玩家不确定自己听到的事情到底严不严重，于是私下问一个比较信任的同事。

turns.prompt: 你想找可信任的同事私下商量遇到的事，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I ask you something in confidence?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you something in confidence?
feedback.explanation: “in confidence”表示私下保密告知，能说明为何不希望内容被转述。

choices.text: I need a second opinion on something that happened today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need a second opinion on something that happened today.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Something happened earlier, and I’m not sure if I’m overthinking it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Something happened earlier, and I’m not sure if I’m overthinking it.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: Have you noticed any tension between me and Chris lately?

feedback.naturalExpression: Have you noticed any tension between me and Chris lately?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

turns.text: Maybe a little. Why? What happened?

turns.prompt: 对方想了解出了什么问题，你会怎样说明情况？

choices.text: I overheard Chris talking about me earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: I overheard Chris talking about me earlier.
feedback.explanation: “I overheard”交代自己听到的信息；如果只听到部分内容，还应留出核实的空间。

choices.text: I heard him say that I’m difficult to work with.

feedback.naturalExpression: I heard him say that I’m difficult to work with.
feedback.explanation: “I heard”交代自己听到的信息；如果只听到部分内容，还应留出核实的空间。

choices.text: I only heard part of the conversation, so I don’t want to jump to conclusions.

feedback.naturalExpression: I only heard part of the conversation, so I don’t want to jump to conclusions.
feedback.explanation: “jump to conclusions”表示过早下结论；否定使用时说明想先核实事实。

choices.text: I’m trying to figure out whether I should address it or just let it go.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m trying to figure out whether I should address it or just let it go.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

turns.text: Do you want my honest opinion?

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: Yeah. I’d rather know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I’d rather know.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Please. I’m trying to understand the situation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please. I’m trying to understand the situation.
feedback.explanation: 说明正在尝试的动作或遇到的困难，帮助对方针对卡住的环节提供协助。

choices.text: Definitely. Just tell me what you’ve noticed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Definitely. Just tell me what you’ve noticed.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

turns.text: I don’t think everyone feels that way, but you and Chris have definitely seemed frustrated with each other lately.

turns.prompt: 关于「同事背后议论自己」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: That’s useful to know. Maybe I should talk to him directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s useful to know. Maybe I should talk to him directly.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Okay. I was worried it was a bigger issue with the whole team.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I was worried it was a bigger issue with the whole team.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Thanks for being straight with me. I’ll think about how to handle it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for being straight with me. I’ll think about how to handle it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I’d rather deal with it before it turns into a bigger problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather deal with it before it turns into a bigger problem.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。
